claim: Workers' remittances fell by 36% year on year in 2022, while parallel-market incentives diverted part of the flow away from formal banking channels.

metric.denominator: workers' remittance inflows recorded through formal channels
metric.basis: Central Bank of Sri Lanka annual external-sector reporting
metric.source_definition: formal recorded workers' remittances; informal-market flows are discussed separately

bounded_by: A fall in recorded remittances reflects both underlying income/flows and channel substitution; it is not equivalent to a 36% fall in all remittance resources available to households.
notes: Keeps remittance quantity and exchange-regime channel distinct.
